CSG FLOOD & EL NINO BULLETIN - Garissa County
Rain outlook (Upper Tana, 14 days): weighted multi-model 256.0 mm; chance of >200 mm 58.1%, >350 mm 29.8%.
River Tana at Garissa: blend peak 2.38 m (WATCH); ECMWF scenario 4.56 m; US-AI scenario 5.01 m. Thresholds 4.0 alert / 5.0 alarm / 6.2 emergency.
Actions: 1) Riverine farmers move pumps, seed and livestock to higher ground. 2) Avoid crossing flowing laghas. 3) Treat drinking water and sleep under nets.
Report emergencies: 1199 | emergency@garissa.go.ke
